STANZA I
My trust is in my heav'nly Friend
My trust is in my heav'nly Friend,
My hope in thee, my God;
Rise, and my helpless life defend
From those that seek my blood.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
The psalm it sets
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 7, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers, 2or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me. 3O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands, 4if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause, … 13 more verses PSALM 7 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 7
